facts.business: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited is engaged in the design, manufacture, and service of aerospace and defence products including fighter aircraft, helicopters, and transport aircraft for the Indian Armed Forces.

auditor.name: M/s. Gupta Nayar & Co., Chartered Accountants, Bengaluru
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on: (I) Pay revision recovery litigation and reversal of claims receivable (Rs 18,565 lakhs for officers, Rs 16,390 lakhs for workmen); (II) Non-compliance with SEBI LODR Regulation 17(1) and Companies Act Section 149(4) on Board composition; (III) Non-compliance with Audit Committee, NRC, SRC, RMC constitution and Board quorum until 1st June 2025 due to insufficient Independent Directors; (IV) Su-30 aircraft crash (SB-182) with insurance claim of Rs 14,435 lakhs and provision of Rs 84,336 lakhs for replacement; (V) C&AG observation on excess PRP payment of Rs 4,318 lakhs (2009-10 to 2011-12) waived by Board; (vi) Going concern uncertainty for subsidiaries MTAL (voluntary liquidation approved), Infotech HAL Ltd (NCLT admitted insolvency), and HAL-Edgewood Technologies (not consolidated, winding up approved).

key_risks: Litigation on pay revision recovery from employees (officers and workmen) with High Court orders
Non-compliance with SEBI LODR and Companies Act on Board composition and Committee constitution
Su-30 aircraft crash leading to customer demand for replacement and large provision (Rs 84,336 lakhs)
Going concern uncertainty for joint ventures/subsidiaries: MTAL (voluntary liquidation), Infotech HAL Ltd (insolvency), HAL-Edgewood (winding up)
C&AG observation on excess PRP payments requiring Board waiver
